title: The Home page, next version — round 2, third look: the TV card

steps.path: Pages → Home, Destin's Room TV, top of the card
steps.headline: Every TV has a round power button on the right; tapping the TV itself opens or closes its remote.
steps.changed: Power used to be the whole tile, so opening the remote meant finding a small separate button. Now the power button lights up in your accent colour while the TV is on, and the arrow beside it shows whether the remote is open.
steps.notice: Opening the remote can never switch the TV off. A TV with no paired remote (the Samsung) has the power button only.
steps.risk: Soundbars and speakers keep the old way: tap the tile to switch them on or off.

steps.headline: What is playing sits in its own block: a Now playing label, the title, and the app it is in, with that app's mark.
steps.changed: The title used to be the grey second line under the name. Now it is a block of its own; on a TV it shows the app's mark (YouTube here), on a speaker a music note. Paused says Paused.
steps.notice: The line under the name now just says Playing, Paused, On or Off.
steps.risk: The app is known only for YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video and Disney+; other apps show the title without a mark.

steps.path: Pages → Home, Destin's Room TV, the remote
steps.headline: The remote is reworked: app buttons are coloured marks with names, a bigger arrow pad, labelled Back, Home and Play/pause, and one volume bar.
steps.changed: The app pills became four marks in each app's own colour. The arrow pad grew, Back/Home/Play/pause got labels under them, and volume down, mute and up are one joined bar below.
steps.notice: The marks are drawn by the page in each app's colour, not downloaded logos.
steps.risk: The remote is tall: open it only when you need it; the page remembers it open or closed.
